Class KeyExchangeGroups

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.ssl.KeyExchangeGroups
@Internal public final class KeyExchangeGroups extends Object
Resolves and validates the TLS key exchange named groups from SslConfiguration.getKeyExchangeGroups() and SslConfiguration.getPqcPolicy().
Since:
5.3.0

    • jdkSupport

      public static Predicate<String> jdkSupport(@Nullable SSLContext context)
      Support check for groups of a JDK SSLContext. A group counts as supported when an engine of the context, restricted to that group, offers exactly that group in its TLS 1.3 ClientHello, so groups the provider does not know or does not enforce are rejected. Groups without a known code point must be listed by SSLContext.getSupportedSSLParameters().
      Parameters:
      context - The context, or null for the default context
      Returns:
      Whether the context supports and enforces a group
